pairs: Filii autem Israël secundum numerum suum,
qui ministrabant regi juxta turmas suas,
who were ministering to the king by their companies,
et egredientes per singulos menses in anno,
entering and departing in each month of the year as they were in charge,
Primæ turmæ in primo mense Jesboam præerat filius Zabdiel,
Jashobeam, the son of Zabdiel, was in charge of the first company in the first month;
et sub eo viginti quatuor millia;
and under him were twenty-four thousand.
He was from the sons of Perez,
princeps cunctorum principum in exercitu mense primo.
and he was the leader of all the other leaders in the army, in the first month.
Secundi mensis habebat turmam Dudia Ahohites,
The company of the second month had Dodai, an Ahohite;
et post se alter nomine Macelloth,
and after him there was another, named Mikloth,
qui regebat partem exercitus viginti quatuor millium.
who ruled over a portion of the army of the twenty-four thousand.
Dux quoque turmæ tertiæ in mense tertio erat Banaias filius Jojadæ sacerdos: et in divisione sua viginti quatuor millia.
Also, the commander of the third company, in the third month, was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the priest; and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.
Ipse est Banaias fortissimus inter triginta,
The same is the Benaiah who was strongest among the thirty,
præerat autem turmæ ipsius Amizabad filius ejus.
But his son, Ammizabad, was in charge of his company.
was Asahel, the brother of Joab,
et Zabadias filius ejus post eum:
and his son Zebadiah after him;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.

et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
was Helez, a Pelonite from the sons of Ephraim;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
was Sibbecai, a Hushathite from the stock of the Zerahites;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
was Abiezer, an Anathothite from the sons of Benjamin;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
et ipse Netophathites de stirpe Zarai:
and he was a Netophathite from the stock of the Zerahites;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
was Benaiah, a Pirathonite from the sons of Ephraim;
et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.

et in turma ejus viginti quatuor millia.
and in his company there were twenty-four thousand.
Now those who were first over the tribes of Israel were these:
Eliezer, the son of Zichri, was the ruler;
Shephatiah, the son of Maacah, was the ruler;
over the one half tribe of Manasseh,
et dimidiæ tribui Manasse in Galaad,
and over the one half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead,
the son of Jeroham, was over Dan.
These were the leaders of the sons of Israel.
Noluit autem David numerare eos a viginti annis inferius:
But David was not willing to number them from twenty years old and under.
quia dixerat Dominus ut multiplicaret Israël quasi stellas cæli.
For the Lord had said that he would multiply Israel like the stars of heaven.
Joab, the son of Zeruiah, had begun to number,
quia super hoc ira irruerat in Israël,
For because of this, wrath had fallen upon Israel.
et idcirco numerus eorum qui fuerant recensiti, non est relatus in fastos regis David.
And therefore the number of those who had been counted was not related in the official records of king David.
Super thesauros autem regis fuit Azmoth filius Adiel:
Now over the storerooms of the king was Azmaveth, the son of Adiel.
But Jonathan, the son of Uzziah,
qui erant in urbibus, et in vicis, et in turribus,
was over those storerooms that were in the cities,
and in the villages, and in the towers.
Operi autem rustico, et agricolis qui exercebant terram,
And over the farmlands and the farmers, those who worked the ground,
was Ezri, the son of Chelub.
And over the cultivators of vineyards was Shimei,
then over the wine cellars was Zabdi,
Now over the olive groves and the fig groves,
et ficeta quæ erant in campestribus,
and over the oil cellars was Joash.
Porro armentis quæ pascebantur in Saron,
Now over the herds that were pastured in Sharon,
Shitrai, a Sharonite, was in the first place;
and over the oxen in the valleys,
there was Shaphat, the son of Adlai.
Truly, over the camels was Obil,
and over the donkeys was Jehdeiah, a Meronothite.
And over the sheep was Jaziz, a Hagarene.
omnes hi, principes substantiæ regis David.
All these were leaders over the substance of king David.
Now Jonathan, the uncle of David,
ipse et Jahiel filius Hachamoni erant cum filiis regis.
he and Jehiel, the son of Hachmoni, were with the sons of the king.
Now Ahithophel was the counselor of the king;
and Hushai, the Archite, was the king’s friend.
Post Achitophel fuit Jojada filius Banaiæ,
After Ahithophel was Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah,
Princeps autem exercitus regis erat Joab.
But the leader of the army of the king was Joab.
